policy: Support bounds for the two household columns the post-geography value node rewrites (microcosm#1240): main_residence_value is winsorised at the value knots' declared cap, and property_wealth moves by the same amount, so its bound is the cap plus the WAS donor bound's headroom over the main residence. Listed after was_wealth_support_bounds.json in uk_support so these bounds win for the two columns. Public caps, never donor values.
